public class Solution {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		String s = "";
		try {
			s = in.nextLine();
		} catch (Exception e) {

		}

	public static int evaluate(String s) {
		int counter = 0;
		int groupCount = 1;
		int len = s.length();
		for (int idx = 0; idx < len; idx++) {
			if (idx + 1 < len && s.charAt(idx) == s.charAt(idx + 1)) {
				groupCount++;
			} else {
				if (groupCount % 2 == 0) {
					counter++;
				}
				groupCount = 1;
			}
		}
		return counter;
	}
}
